title: nbands equals the physical basis dimension

nbands.meaning: Number of bands; must equal the physical basis dimension nbasis and must never truncate the basis.

constraints: Count nbasis from the .orb channels with degeneracy s=1, p=3, d=5, f=7, g=9, h=11, i=13, j=15, k=17, sum over radial channels and atoms, and multiply by 2 when SOC is enabled.
nbands cannot exceed nbasis; a state window capped by the basis dimension (bn-k222 lesson) is a property of the basis, not a reason to lower nbands.
